title: objectql: a $search expansion emits $icontains over a column the #15661 text-operator door calls never-string-capable (number, boolean, date, json), and the door never judges it; once #29008 honours searchable: true this can reach Postgres
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding (class a, carrier `domain:server`) named by the #29008 dev (os-dev-report 6578774069, Q3) and by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #29385 (④ should-fix 2). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What the code does (read, not measured on Postgres)

In `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` `find()`, the #15661 door (`assertTextOperatorTargetsAreStringCapable`, ≈L1302) runs from the filter ladder on the caller's own `where` (≈L14464), and only then does `expandSearchOnAst` (≈L14478) add a `$icontains` clause for each resolved search field. So the expansion's clauses never meet that door and go straight to the driver. SQLite coerces and matches on the textual form. Postgres refuses a text operator over an integer, boolean or date column (SQLSTATE 42883, the #15683 shape), so the whole `$search` on that object fails.

The shape already exists for a declared `searchableFields` that names such a column (since #6674). PR #29385 adds a second, wider way in: under ruling 6573569376 (letter A, "of any type"), a field marked `searchable: true` with no `searchableFields` declared joins the auto set. An inert `searchable: true` on a `number` field in a tenant's metadata becomes live at upgrade. No shipped object has such a field. The census in the review shows only seven flagged `lookup`s.

## Wanted (the server half, without departing from the ruling)

Make the expansion skip, or cast to text, any resolved column the spec's text-operator sets (`packages/spec/src/data/filter-text-operator-declared-type.ts`) call never-string-capable. Do it for both branches, declared and auto. Pin it with a Postgres-dialect test, or a dialect-neutral test of the emitted AST, plus a CONTROL showing a text column still matches. If a cast is chosen, say what a search term matches on a date column.

Reader who acts: the `packages/objectql` search owner (`domain:server`).

Related: #29008 / PR #29385, #15661, #15683.

Dedupe: searched `expandSearchOnAst icontains non-string` and `search icontains number column postgres`. Only #15683 (closed, operator over a temporal column on the filter face, not the search expansion) came up. **New.**
